description: Level set methods for shape optimization can find extremal domains for B_u. Domain boundary evolves via Hamilton-Jacobi PDE driven by shape gradient of the Bloch radius functional.
mathematical_formalization: Omega = {x : phi(x) > 0}. Shape derivative: dJ/dt = int_{partial Omega} v_n * g ds. Hamilton-Jacobi: partial phi/partial t + v_n |nabla phi| = 0.
analogical_connections: Level set domain evolution ~ front propagation in combustion
Shape gradient for Bloch constant ~ adjoint sensitivity in aerodynamic optimization
Topology changes ~ phase transitions in materials science
implementation_hypothesis: Level-set optimizer for simply connected domains: compute conformal map, evaluate inradius, compute shape derivative, update level set.
experiment_seed: Start from unit disk, run level set optimizer to maximize inradius(f(D)). Compare final shapes with known candidates.
